patterns: Mostly direct definitions: byte = 8 bits, RAM volatile / ROM permanent / BIOS in ROM, cache fastest, CPU = brain, ALU expansion, Babbage father of computer, Tim Berners-Lee WWW.
Classification items recur: input vs output device groups, system vs application software ('MS Word is application'), not-a-language/not-an-OS odd-one-out (APPSC 2019 Python vs OSes).
APPSC asks expansions (MPEG, ICT) and simple concept items (multimedia, bandwidth, AI) rather than statement sets.
App uses multi-statement formats on gates, Boolean identities, OS types and 2026 supercomputer news - deeper than PYQs but factually sound.
